issues.description: Class 'Bitmap24' is default-constructed in example_program/src/main.cpp (Bitmap24 bitmap;), and the implementation file example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp defines a default constructor Bitmap24::Bitmap24(). However, the template repository header example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp does not declare a default constructor (it only declares Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height);). The solution repository header does declare the default constructor. This API mismatch (definition + call vs. missing declaration in the header) will cause a compilation error for students using the template: main.cpp expects a visible default constructor but the template header does not expose it.
issues.suggestedFix: Declare the default constructor in the template header to match the implementation and usage. Add the line 'Bitmap24();' (no parameters) to example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp (for example immediately before the existing parameterized constructor declaration) so the header, implementation, and call sites are consistent and the project compiles.
